name: The Source-Checking Skeptic
effect: Turns nearly every prompt into a talk about epistemic trust: it opens with 'As an AI' disclaimers, keeps mentioning verifying accuracy, source reliability, cross-checking and 'your own judgment', and sometimes refuses simple tasks such as g
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Near miss: judged alone, it failed only the strict specificity check. A random neuron (sham control).
